name: Parks and Recreation
description: A mid-level bureaucrat in a small Indiana town tries to make her community better, one park at a time.

episodes.title: Pawnee Zoo
episodes.premise: Leslie accidentally marries two male penguins at the Pawnee Zoo, sparking a citywide debate on gay marriage and making her a polarizing figure overnight.

episodes.title: Sister City
episodes.premise: A delegation from Pawnee's Venezuelan sister city visits, led by a miniature dictator who insults everything while the parks department tries to be gracious hosts.

episodes.title: Hunting Trip
episodes.premise: Leslie takes the guys on a hunting trip to prove she's one of them, but when someone accidentally shoots Ron she takes the blame to protect a colleague's secret.

episodes.title: Galentine's Day
episodes.premise: Leslie hosts her annual celebration of female friendship the day before Valentine's Day, but her attempt to reunite her mom with an old flame backfires catastrophically.

episodes.title: Summer Catalog
episodes.premise: Leslie obsesses over the parks department summer catalog while Ron's emotional walls crack when a woman at a woodworking shop sees through his stoic facade.

episodes.title: The Master Plan
episodes.premise: State auditors Ben Wyatt and Chris Traeger arrive to slash Pawnee's budget, and Leslie meets Ben for the first time with immediate adversarial chemistry.

episodes.title: Flu Season
episodes.premise: Leslie delivers a critical presentation to save the Harvest Festival while delirious with the flu, cycling between collapse and manic brilliance as her friends prop her up.

episodes.title: Ron and Tammy
episodes.premise: Ron's terrifying ex-wife Tammy Two returns and transforms him into a feral, cornrow-wearing man-child while Leslie desperately tries to break her spell.

episodes.title: Camping
episodes.premise: Leslie drags the department on an overnight camping trip to brainstorm the Harvest Festival and has her eureka moment at 4 AM while everyone else suffers in the cold.

episodes.title: The Fight
episodes.premise: Ann and Leslie get into a brutal drunken argument at a nightclub over Leslie taking Ann for granted, fueled by Tom's horrifying new liquor brand Snake Juice.

episodes.title: Ron and Tammys
episodes.premise: Ron's mother Tammy One arrives in Pawnee and reduces Ron to a terrified, obedient child, proving there's someone even scarier than Tammy Two.

episodes.title: Treat Yo Self
episodes.premise: Tom and Donna celebrate their annual 'Treat Yo Self' day of extravagant self-indulgence while trying to get Ben to join them and finally break his emotional repression.

episodes.title: The Treaty
episodes.premise: Ben and Leslie's breakup tension explodes during a Model UN simulation where their fictional countries wage escalating war while their students watch in confusion.

episodes.title: Win, Lose, or Draw
episodes.premise: Election night arrives and Leslie waits for results in her city council race, the culmination of a season-long campaign, with her entire future hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Halloween Surprise
episodes.premise: Ben surprises Leslie with an early return from Washington and proposes in the most Ben Wyatt way possible while Andy hunts a possum through the office wearing a costume.

episodes.title: Women in Garbage
episodes.premise: Leslie and April ride along on a garbage truck to prove women can do any city job, finding it far harder than expected while Ron mentors a young girl at a woodworking class.

episodes.title: Leslie and Ben
episodes.premise: Leslie and Ben get married in a surprise impromptu ceremony at their workplace, surrounded by friends, after their actual wedding plans keep falling apart.

episodes.title: Bailout
episodes.premise: Leslie must decide whether to bail out a failing video rental store, testing her principles against reality, while Tom launches his new restaurant venture Rent-a-Swag.

episodes.title: Doppelgangers
episodes.premise: The Pawnee and Eagleton parks departments merge and each employee meets their counterpart, forcing uncomfortable conversations about who gets to keep their job.

episodes.title: New Beginnings
episodes.premise: Leslie starts her new job at the National Parks Service and realizes her ambition has grown beyond Pawnee while Andy accidentally becomes a beloved children's TV star.

episodes.title: Leslie and Ron
episodes.premise: Leslie and Ron are locked in the parks office overnight and finally confront why their friendship fell apart during the three-year time jump, rebuilding it piece by piece.

episodes.title: One Last Ride
episodes.premise: The series finale follows each character's future as they complete one final parks project together, flashing forward to show how their lives unfold over the decades.
